summary.en: Full product rebrand update notes. The agent binary is semantix-agent; user data lives in ~/.semantix and project files in .semantix/; the project config is semantix-agent.toml; environment variables use the SEMANTIX_ prefix. Legacy plugin manifests still load.
summary.zh: 全量品牌整合版更新日志。代理可执行文件为 semantix-agent；用户数据目录迁至 ~/.semantix，项目内为 .semantix/；项目配置改名 semantix-agent.toml；环境变量统一 SEMANTIX_ 前缀。旧版插件清单仍可读取。

body.en: CLI output, embedded docs, protocol identifiers, crash-report endpoints, and on-disk paths now all use the Semantix name.
body.zh: CLI 输出、内置文档、协议标识、崩溃上报端点与落盘路径全面使用 Semantix 命名。

body.en: Data under the old ~/.reasonix directory is not read automatically; move it to ~/.semantix or re-add your projects. Provider keys stored in the OS keyring must be entered again.
body.zh: 旧目录 ~/.reasonix 中的数据不会自动读取；可手动迁移至 ~/.semantix，或在新版中重新添加项目。保存在系统钥匙串中的 provider 密钥需要重新输入。

summary.en: The coding-agent harness and the self-evolving memory kernel ship as one package for the first time: semantix-agent runs interactive sessions while the semantix CLI builds, retrieves, and injects the slice library.
summary.zh: 编码代理 harness 与自进化记忆内核首次合并打包发布：semantix-agent 负责交互会话，semantix CLI 负责构建、检索并注入切片库。

body.en: Sessions automatically look up and inject relevant slices from the project memory library.
body.zh: 会话自动从项目记忆库检索并注入相关切片。
